name: Motive MCP
description: The Motive MCP connector lets Claude inspect and manage dealership website data through the Motive platform. It can help update dealer details, review inventory, manage website content, forms, navigation, and merchandising settings, and support common dealership site operations without switching tools. This makes it easier for teams to maintain accurate, up-to-date dealer experiences directly from Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Motive MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Motive MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.app.ridemotive.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Motive MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Motive MCP provides these MCP tools: api_docs, execute, and report_issue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Motive MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Motive MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Motive MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Motive MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Motive MCP is developed by Motive. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
